name: tui-tester
title_zh: 终端里给 Gemini CLI 做行为与视觉回归的测
tagline_zh: 不用手敲命令猜输出，它教你用终端自动化脚本，把 Gemini CLI 的每次行为变化和渲染结果都钉在测试用例里。
tagline_en: Stop guessing CLI output. Learn to script terminal automation that pins down Gemini CLI behavior and rendered.
desc_en: Expert guidance for testing Gemini CLI behavior and visual output using terminal automation.
why_zh: 它把「测试 CLI」从玄学变成工程：不只测退出码，还盯终端渲染的像素级差异，适合给交互式工具上保险。
why_en: Turns CLI testing into engineering: asserts not just exit codes but pixel-level terminal rendering, built for interactive tool.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Gemini CLI 的行为与终端视觉输出，不涉及单元测试或非终端 UI。
limit_en: Only covers Gemini CLI behavior & terminal visuals; no unit tests or non-terminal UIs. Requires existing terminal automation setup (tmux/expect) and.
title_en: A testing guide for Gemini CLI behavior & visual output.
